{"claims":[{"claim_text":"All corporations owe it to their shareholders to fully analyze and disclose the risks they face, including climate risk.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Those who fail to fully analyze and disclose the risks they face, including climate risk, should be held accountable.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats respectfully request the Department of Justice to investigate allegations of corporate fraud on the part of fossil fuel companies accused of misleading shareholders and the public on the scientific reality of climate change.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe in the conservation and collaborative stewardship of America's shared natural heritage: the public lands and waterways, the oceans, Everglades, Great Lakes, and the Arctic.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support policies and investments that will keep America's public lands public.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support strengthening protections for America's natural and cultural resources.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support increasing access to parks and public lands for all Americans.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support protecting native species and wildlife.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support harnessing the immense economic and social potential of America's public lands and waters.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will work to establish an American Parks Trust Fund to help expand local, state, and national recreational opportunities.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will work to establish an American Parks Trust Fund to help rehabilitate existing parks.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will work to establish an American Parks Trust Fund to help enhance America's great outdoors.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Democrats are committed to doubling the size of the outdoor economy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Doubling the size of the outdoor economy will create nearly hundreds of billions of dollars in new economic activity.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Doubling the size of the outdoor economy will create millions of new jobs.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[4]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
